# Sarat Test Data Factory — Purchasing Module · Phase A (Read-only Review)

**Status:** Read-only Reviewed / No seed designed / No DB writes · Staging = Not confirmed · Posting Engine = Under Audit / Partially Audited

Phase A per the governance plan (`ERP_STAGING_TEST_DATA_FACTORY_PLAN.md` §7): schema · triggers · functions · service call-sites · existing live examples · risks. No seed is designed here. This is the second module reviewed (after Sales).

---

## 1. Schema Evidence

**purchase_invoices** — required (NOT NULL, no default): `code` (generated by trigger). Defaulted: `status`='draft', `invoice_date`, `total`=0, `currency`='SAR'. Supplier link: both `supplier_id` and `contact_id` (duplication — see R-P1; identical in all live rows). `invoice_no` nullable (external supplier number vs internal `code`). `po_id`/`grn_id`/`allocation_id` link to order/receipt/allocation. `paid_amount` present — confirms SAP Open Item is NOT applied to AP (see R-P2 / TECH-DEBT-AP-001).

**purchase_invoice_lines** — required: `invoice_id` (plus `line_no`/`unit_cost`/`net_cost`/`line_total` defaulted). `net_cost` (NOT NULL) is the Purchase-Cost Bridge source (→ `inventory_items.cost_price`). No `vehicle_id` column — vehicle data carried directly (vin/brand/manufacturer/model/trim/year/color/engine_no); the vehicle is created from the purchase, not linked to an existing one.

**purchase_payments** — required: `amount` (`code` defaulted `PPAY-YYYYMMDD-xxxxxx`). `approval_status` default 'draft'. Both `supplier_id` and `contact_id`. Has a `journal_entry_id` column (linked back by the trigger). Approval fields present.

## 2. Triggers Evidence

**purchase_orders:** `trg_po_no` (BEFORE INSERT → number).

**purchase_invoices** (3): `trg_guard_pinv_from_unapproved_po` (BEFORE INSERT — blocks a PINV whose `po_id` points to a non-approved PO; **`po_id` NULL passes**, so a direct invoice is allowed) · `trg_pinv_code` (BEFORE INSERT → `code`) · `trg_purchase_invoice_je` (AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OF status → AP journal entry).

**purchase_payments** (3): `trg_ppay_code` (BEFORE INSERT → `code`) · `trg_supplier_payment_je_insert` (AFTER INSERT) · `trg_supplier_payment_je_update` (AFTER UPDATE WHEN `approval_status` changed) → both call `trg_supplier_payment_je_conditional`.

No trigger creates `inventory_items` from a purchase invoice (see §4, Purchase-Cost Bridge).

## 3. Functions Evidence

**create_purchase_invoice_journal_entry** — fires when `status` IN (approved/posted/paid/partially_paid/confirmed) — NOT 'issued' (unlike Sales). Idempotent on `journal_entries`. Posts: Dr Inventory (`PURCHASE_INVENTORY`) = total − vat, Dr VAT input (`PURCHASE_VAT_INPUT`) if vat>0, Cr AP (`PURCHASE_AP`, `partner_type='vendor'`, `contact_id`) = total. Accounts resolved by role. Does not touch `inventory_items`.

**trg_supplier_payment_je_conditional** — posts only when `approval_status='approved'` (on INSERT, or on UPDATE transitioning to approved). Idempotent on `journal_entries`; links `journal_entry_id` back into `purchase_payments`. Posts: Dr AP (`PURCHASE_AP`, vendor, contact_id) / Cr cash (`SUPPLIER_PAYMENT_PAY`). Partner-tracked. No allocation / open item is created (AP relies on `paid_amount` — TECH-DEBT-AP-001).

## 4. Purchase-Cost Bridge

No DB trigger converts a purchase invoice line into an `inventory_items` (vehicle) row. The bridge (`net_cost` → `cost_price`, and vehicle creation) is done in the code/service layer, separately from the invoice. Consequence: the purchase invoice's journal entry (AP) is independent of inventory creation — a **plain purchase invoice (no vehicle) is enough to generate an AP balance**; seeding a purchased vehicle (full cycle) is a different, code-driven workflow.

## 5. Existing Live Examples

- **PINV-2026-0003** — draft, `po_id` set, je_count=0 (draft ⇒ no JE, consistent), 0 lines.
- **PINV-2026-0002** — confirmed, `po_id` set, je_count=1, 1 line.
- **PINV-2026-0001** — partially_paid, `po_id` set, je_count=1, 2 lines.

All three have `po_id` set (no live `po_id=NULL` example, though the guard allows it). `contact_id` = `supplier_id` in every row (identical — R-P1). JE appears at confirmed+ (draft has none). Invoice-number patterns are messy (PINV-TEST-001 / 1234 / INV-RED-001) — test-data artifact. Contact 2531b06a (customer + supplier) has a PINV, so an AP balance for a settlement (T4) exists live.

## 6. Purchasing Workflow Model

```
purchase_order (trg_po_no, approval_status)
  → [approve]
purchase_invoice (trg_pinv_code + PO guard + AP JE at confirmed+; po_id=NULL bypasses guard)
  → purchase_payment (trg_ppay_code + Dr AP / Cr cash JE at approved)
[separate, code] Purchase-Cost Bridge: net_cost → inventory_items.cost_price + vehicle creation
```

## 7. Scenario Matrix (outline — filled in Phase B, not now)

| scenario | workflow | evidence | accounting | raw SQL? |
|----------|----------|----------|-----------|----------|
| AP balance (simple) | INSERT purchase_invoices (po_id=NULL, confirmed, contact_id) | guard allows | Dr Inventory / Cr AP (vendor) | workflow-consistent |
| PINV from PO | PO → approve → INSERT PINV (po_id) | PINV-0001/0002 | same + guard | workflow-consistent |
| Supplier payment | INSERT purchase_payments (approved, contact_id, amount) | — | Dr AP / Cr cash (vendor) | workflow-consistent |
| Purchase vehicle | PINV + [code] create inventory_items | — | AP + inventory (separate) | mixed (Phase B) |

## 8. Risks / Candidates

- **R-P1 (candidate, not promoted):** `supplier_id`/`contact_id` duplication on purchase_invoices and purchase_payments. Identical in all live rows, no current harm; the JE function uses `contact_id` (with `supplier_name` fallback). Structural risk only if they ever diverge.
- **R-P2 (confirmed debt = TECH-DEBT-AP-001):** SAP Open Item standard is not applied to AP — `paid_amount` + draft/confirmed statuses, no allocations. Confirmed by both schema and the payment function (no allocation created).
- **R-P3:** messy `invoice_no` patterns (PINV-TEST-001 / 1234 / INV-RED-001) — test-data artifact, not structural.
- **R-P4 (candidate):** purchase status vocabulary (draft/confirmed/approved/posted/partially_paid) is not the SAP Open Item vocabulary (OPEN/PARTIALLY_CLEARED/CLEARED/CANCELLED) — part of TECH-DEBT-AP-001.

## 9. Recommendation

Purchasing Phase A is Read-only Reviewed (core + G-P1 supplier payment + G-P2 cost bridge + G-P3 live examples). The real flow: purchase_order → (approve) → purchase_invoice (AP JE at confirmed+) → purchase_payment (approved) → cost bridge (code) for inventory. A simple AP balance seed is a direct PINV (po_id=NULL, confirmed) plus a PPAY (approved) — both workflow-consistent. Purchasing a vehicle needs the separate code-driven cost bridge.

Next: Phase B (seed design) — deferred until staging is confirmed. TECH-DEBT-AP-001 remains the standing high-priority AP debt.
